description: Minimal, hand-derived schema for alb.networking.azure.io/v1 IngressExtension (Application Gateway for Containers). No official OpenAPI schema is published anywhere kubeconform can fetch (datreeio/CRDs-catalog has no alb.networking.azure.io entries as of this writing, and the ALB Controller's own Helm chart ships no CRD manifests — Azure/Application-Gateway-for-Containers-Migration-Utility only carries Go struct definitions, not a schema). Covers exactly the shape this chart's own charts-common.ingress.redirectAzure define emits (spec.rules[].host + requestRedirect.scheme/statusCode) -- deliberately not the full upstream spec (rewrites, backendSettings, sessionAffinity, path-based redirects), which this chart doesn't generate. Widen this file if a future feature starts emitting more of the real spec.
